title: One recovery experience, better GPU rail and reactive 24-word activation
changes: Place the secure browser-only recovery form in the existing Setup content column while keeping the GPU identity rail visible; no full-screen modal or secrets passed into QML.
Style the WebAssembly reveal-words checkbox and keyboard focus to match GenyCaster's neutral theme rather than default browser-blue controls.
Make native recovery's Continue action react to every entered or pasted word using a live 24-field completion count.
Refine the light/dark GPU studio rail with tonal porcelain/sapphire lighting and restrained softboxes.
